note: Repository semantic graph ontology. Edges are entity-to-entity and remain separate from source occurrences that locate evidence in a file.

route.note: Includes route handlers; the existing routes.route_type distinguishes page from route-handler. Not a separate kind, so one path never gets two identities.

component.note: A symbol that returns JSX. Shares the symbol key namespace; a key resolves to exactly one node, classified by the most specific kind.

server-function.note: A callable symbol declared behind a file- or function-scoped use server directive. Shares the symbol key namespace.

cache-key.note: A cache tag or path named by cacheTag/revalidateTag/updateTag/revalidatePath/refresh.

backend-endpoint.note: e.g. 'POST ${GATEWAY_URL}/pages/aboutus/insertcomment'. The template keeps the config entity visible instead of baking in a value.

verification-command.note: Runnable test, typecheck, lint or build command with package.json evidence. A command is not coverage unless a validated-by relation supports that claim.

capability.note: Only created from a human-approved source; never inferred from paths.

imports.note: Reachability only. Must never on its own justify a behavioural claim about the source.

references.note: An imported symbol used in value position without being called. Weaker than `calls` but symbol-precise, unlike `imports`. Required for dynamic dispatch: a provider registered in a record literal is reached only through this edge.

fetches.note: derived when the target is assembled from constants or template literals

submits-to.note: Requires resolving the request target constant; RCE-010.

validated-by.note: Created only when a concrete test case uses the imported target or names a known route; importing a module elsewhere in the test file is insufficient.

declares.note: .env declaration; environment carried on the occurrence, not the edge.

tags.note: cacheTag associates a cache scope with a statically named tag.

invalidates.note: revalidateTag, updateTag, revalidatePath or refresh invalidates/refreshes the named cache target.

affected-by.note: Never stored. A stored reverse edge goes stale the moment any input edge changes.

implemented-by.note: Derived from human-approved capability definitions only.
